title: Probability-only open-set rules for 5G intrusion detection: pipeline, per-cell result records, unit tests, and numeric-claim verification
description: Reproducibility artifact for the manuscript of the same subject. Contains: (1) the full experimental pipeline for the open-set rejection study on 5G-NIDD, covering four base classifiers (LightGBM, XGBoost, TabNet, FT-Transformer) and four probability-space rejection rules (MSP, energy, Mahalanobis, KNN-OOD); (2) the per-cell result records behind every reported number, one JSON record per experimental cell across the main, per-attack, temperature and destinations campaigns; (3) the aggregated metric tables and campaign logs; (4) a pytest suite covering the scoring rules; (5) verify_openset_numbers.py, which re-derives every numeric claim in the manuscript from the result records so that a stale number fails loudly. The 5G-NIDD dataset itself is distributed by its own authors and is NOT redistributed here; the loader consumes their published Encoded.csv and asserts its row and per-class counts on load.
notes: CPU-only runs on a single workstation. The four open-set campaigns total about 27.9 hours of job time across 128 jobs, dominated by FT-Transformer. The repository shares a data loader and a job driver with a separate cross-station study by the same group; neither reports a result that depends on the other.
